001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.command.CommandManager;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.database.DatabaseHelper;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory.InventoryWrapperRegistry;
006import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.localization.text.TextManager;
007import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.registry.RegistryManager;
008import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.ItemMatcher;
009import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.PlayerFinder;
010import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.ShopControlPanelManager;
011import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.ShopItemBlackList;
012import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.ShopManager;
013import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.interaction.InteractionManager;
014import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.tag.TagManager;
015import com.vdurmont.semver4j.Semver;
016import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
017import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
018import org.bukkit.plugin.RegisteredServiceProvider;
019import org.jetbrains.annotations.ApiStatus;
020import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
021
022import java.util.Map;
023
024/**
025 * The unique entry point to allow you to access most features of QuickShop
026 */
027public interface QuickShopAPI {
028
029  static QuickShopAPI getInstance() {
030
031    final RegisteredServiceProvider<QuickShopProvider> provider = Bukkit.getServicesManager().getRegistration(QuickShopProvider.class);
032    if(provider == null) {
033      throw new IllegalStateException("QuickShop hadn't loaded at this moment.");
034    }
035    return provider.getProvider().getApiInstance();
036  }
037
038  static Plugin getPluginInstance() {
039
040    final RegisteredServiceProvider<QuickShopProvider> provider = Bukkit.getServicesManager().getRegistration(QuickShopProvider.class);
041    if(provider == null) {
042      throw new IllegalStateException("QuickShop hadn't loaded at this moment.");
043    }
044    return provider.getPlugin();
045  }
046
047
048  /**
049   * Getting command manager that allow addon direct access QuickShop sub-command system
050   *
051   * @return The command manager
052   */
053  CommandManager getCommandManager();
054
055  /**
056   * Getting the helper to directly access the database
057   *
058   * @return The database helper
059   */
060  DatabaseHelper getDatabaseHelper();
061
062  /**
063   * Getting this server game version
064   *
065   * @return Game version
066   */
067  GameVersion getGameVersion();
068
069  /**
070   * Gets registry of InventoryWrappers
071   *
072   * @return registry
073   */
074  @NotNull
075  InventoryWrapperRegistry getInventoryWrapperRegistry();
076
077  /**
078   * Getting current using ItemMatcher impl
079   *
080   * @return The item matcher
081   */
082  ItemMatcher getItemMatcher();
083
084  /**
085   * Getting the mapping of permission to shop amounts
086   *
087   * @return Permissions <-> Shop Amounts mapping
088   *
089   * @deprecated Replaced by RankLimiter
090   */
091  @ApiStatus.Obsolete
092  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true)
093  Map<String, Integer> getLimits();
094
095  /**
096   * Getting the control panel manager
097   *
098   * @return Shop control panel manager
099   */
100  ShopControlPanelManager getShopControlPanelManager();
101
102  /**
103   * Retrieves the InteractionManager associated with this QuickShopProvider.
104   *
105   * @return The InteractionManager that manages InteractionBehaviors and InteractionTypes.
106   */
107  InteractionManager getInteractionManager();
108
109  /**
110   * Getting Shop Manager which managing most of shops
111   *
112   * @return Shop manager
113   */
114  ShopManager getShopManager();
115
116  /**
117   * Getting text manager that allow addon to create a user language locale based message
118   *
119   * @return The text maanger
120   */
121  TextManager getTextManager();
122
123  /** Gets the player-specific shop tag, favorite, and watch index. */
124  TagManager tagManager();
125
126  /**
127   * Getting QuickShop current stacking item support status
128   *
129   * @return Stacking Item support enabled
130   */
131  boolean isAllowStack();
132
133  /**
134   * Getting QuickShop current display item support status
135   *
136   * @return Display item enabled
137   */
138  boolean isDisplayEnabled();
139
140  /**
141   * Getting shop limit system status false if limit system is disabled
142   *
143   * @return Limit enabled
144   *
145   * @deprecated Replaced by RankLimiter
146   */
147  @ApiStatus.Obsolete
148  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true)
149  boolean isLimit();
150
151  RankLimiter getRankLimiter();
152
153  PlayerFinder getPlayerFinder();
154
155  /**
156   * Check if fee required for changing shop price
157   *
158   * @return requires fee
159   */
160  boolean isPriceChangeRequiresFee();
161
162  /**
163   * Logs a event into logs database / file
164   *
165   * @param eventObject event object, must can be serialized by Gson.
166   */
167  void logEvent(@NotNull Object eventObject);
168
169  /**
170   * Register a localized translation key mapping to another key or fixed string
171   *
172   * @param translationKey the key to
173   * @param key            the key to map to or a fixed string
174   */
175  void registerLocalizedTranslationKeyMapping(@NotNull String translationKey, @NotNull String key);
176
177  Semver getSemVersion();
178
179  ShopItemBlackList getShopItemBlackList();
180
181  RegistryManager getRegistry();
182}
